summary_1line: Mahaparshwa urges Ravana to take Sita by force; Ravana responds by beginning a past tale about encountering the nymph Punjikasthala.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana sits enraged on his throne while the general Mahaparshwa stands before him with folded palms, urging him to seize Sita without fear.
The celestial nymph Punjikasthala flashes across the sky on her way to worship Brahma as Ravana suddenly notices her.
